entities.summary: Oleh Stepanovych Musiy is a Ukrainian medic, social activist, organizer of the medical service at Euromaidan, Minister of Healthcare of Ukraine in Yatsenyuk Government from 27 February 2014 till 2 December 2014. On 1 October he was dismissed from his post "for failure to ensure tender procurements of required medicines". In July 2014 Musiy had complained about his lack of power to dismiss some of his deputies appointed by exiled former President Viktor Yanukovych's son Oleksandr Yanukovych: "I kept saying: do something, because people like these have to be in jail".
